The other three sections, from x=560 to x=1760, have dashed INK outlines of 3 px (dash 12 px, gap 8 px) along the top edge, the bottom edge and the right edge at x=1760, plus dashed vertical dividers at x=960 and x=1360 running from y=470 to y=670; the 100% edge at x=560 stays solid. Below the band draw five short solid INK tick lines from y=670 to y=700 at x=160, 560, 960, 1360 and 1760. Under the ticks, left to right, write the labels 0%, 100%, 200%, 300%, 400% in INK, 38 px, centred on the ticks at y=745. On a second row at y=805 write (0), (1), (2), (3), (4) in INK, 38 px, centred under the same ticks. Mark exactly one value: a vertical INK arrow at x=520 (90%, which is 160 + 4 x 90). The shaft is a 4 px line from y=690 up to y=400, it crosses the band, and a filled triangular arrowhead (22 px wide, 30 px long) points up with its tip at y=370.
